book.name: Ma꞉tiyu
book.title: Ka꞉dle molo atlale yu Ma꞉tiyuta ilimale Ma꞉tiyu

content: Saitenta Yesuye elemala natili
Hela꞉dle Sokota Yesuye dalupa dulu dla semtaiyo, Saitenta ya꞉ye elemala natilipo depame.
Ya꞉ 40 alila mate utula꞉la mate daya dimi sela꞉le oloma dla ma daya ta꞉le patota ya꞉ dla puaiyo.
Epalati Saitenta puame Yesu watle epo atlaiyo, “Wa꞉ ikadepe God Yami dlepiye, wa꞉ ewala hutiye i atlane daya yiyelepo depame,” diyo.
Amasiyama Yesuta epo atlaiyo, “God yu bukata epo atlapo,

content.text: ‘Oplamitapo daya siyapo tlo demhalemama pasakalo pohallowa.
Amasiyama ya꞉ God yu tlo daya some demhalemama pasakalo hallepe,’” diyo.

content: Epame matle Saitenta Yesu seme Yelusalem dla taiyo. Epame aiyalma aya dopuko di ikadepe dla Yesuye pamelepame ya꞉ watle epo atlaiyo,
“Wa꞉ ikadepe God Yami dlepiye, wa꞉ dopuko di itle ta꞉la dla putuko dene. Adipalati, God yu bukata epo atlapo,

content.text: Epalati yia꞉tapo wa꞉ye yia꞉ dota hamelepe,
wa꞉ heteta tulume ewala dla heyulala depame.’”

content: Amasiyama Yesuta epo atlaiyo, “God yu bukata ma epo atlapo,

content.text: ‘Wa꞉ Lod wa꞉ Godta itiyamale natilowedeme ya꞉ye elemala natimiya,’” diyo.

content: Saiten matle Yesu seme tamali pato di dla hetaiyo. Epame ya꞉ watle ta꞉lamo patotota yia꞉ta itiyamale mate hela꞉dle mate hutiye kokoye nalati-iyo.
Epame Saitenta ma ya꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Wa꞉ na꞉ dla heodepo siyele ta꞉dlepiye, na꞉tapo ta꞉lamo pato iye wa꞉ watle hamilowepo,” diyo.
Epalati Yesuta ya꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Saiten, wa꞉ na꞉ tle alikili a꞉ma tane. Adipalati, God yu bukata epo atlapo,

content.text: ‘Wa꞉ hatlo Lod wa꞉ God dla heodepo siyele ta꞉demama ya꞉ yu dla salladepo sela꞉ne.’”

content: Epapele oloma edla Saitentapo Yesu saliyome taiyo. Epalati banakaka sotapo Yesuye puame gadiyo.
Yesuta Ga꞉lili dla ya꞉ oko kotiyamale
Yesutapo Yon opa yú dla ka꞉ka꞉timalalo oplamiye amtuwale aya dla ka꞉stale dalepame ma Ga꞉lili dla ilamtaiyo.
Ya꞉ Nasalet mo saliyome ma Kapaniyem mo dla halla taiyo. Kapaniyem mo iye Ga꞉lili kaula peleyama dla halapo. Ta꞉la eye Sebulun mate epo Naptali mate yia꞉ asiyadulo ta꞉layo.
Koko itapo mo-woyamaiyo, God tle yu hapame molo atlalo oplami Aisayatapo atlale mate ala꞉lowedeme. Adipalati, ya꞉ta yu ipo atluwapo,

content.text: “Ga꞉lili so, wua꞉ po-Yu so mate ha꞉ha꞉po.
Wua꞉ ta꞉laye Ga꞉lili kaula peleyama dla elapo, Yoden aloma seme dla.
Epame opata wua꞉ ta꞉laye Sebulun mate epo Naptali mate yia꞉ ta꞉la demdepo.
Opa amtuwale dulu dla ha꞉ha꞉lalo so, wua꞉ hela꞉dle pato natilipe.
Epame powaleta bopudepo ha꞉ha꞉lalo so, wua꞉ dla hela꞉dle patota pulupe.”

content: Epame oloma edla Yesutapo God yu imolowe kotiyamama epo imsela꞉iyo, “Wua꞉ malamale meyelope depame wua꞉ bobtalimale tle heheletimaiya. Adipalati, Pepele dimo kokota puluweye mo-mateka꞉pi,” demsela꞉iyo.
Yesutapo ya꞉ alotle tlalo so ka꞉yapa hohomale

Alila haleta Yesu Ga꞉lili kaula peleyama tle polomyemama amalo halomsiyamalalo so opa dapiyamte Saimon mate epo ya꞉ ei Endulu mate tlamaiyo. Saimon ya꞉ hi haleye Pitayo. Epapeleye yia꞉ mata yú dulu dla hatitimsiyamalati Yesuta pumama yia꞉ natiyo.
Epame yia꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Wua꞉ na꞉ dolumpumulaiya. Wua꞉ ka꞉yapa amalo halomalalo so depo ha꞉ha꞉uwapo. Amasiyama ma wata oloma itle wua꞉ opaye ma God dla elempulalo so depo ha꞉ha꞉lepe,” diyo.
Epalati yia꞉ yu e dalepame yia꞉ mata medla pomelepame Yesu mate tamalaiyo.

Epame yia꞉ etle ma tamalemama amalo halomsiyamalalo so opa opi tlamaiyo, Sebedi ya꞉ akimlala dapiyamte Yeims mate epo ya꞉ ei Yon mate. Yia꞉ye yia꞉ a mate koa dulu dla mata dinampopa꞉iyo. Epalati Yesuta yia꞉ watle epo atlaiyo, “Na꞉ dolumpumulaiya,” diyo.
Epalati yia꞉ yu e dalepame yia꞉ mata mate epo yia꞉ a mate koa dulu medla salepame Yesu mate tamalaiyo.
Yesuta esusulumale so ka꞉ka꞉dle

Epedeme Yesu Ga꞉lili mo pato dulu dla mo yimlala hapuloma dulu dla sela꞉mama yia꞉ta inoma sumalalo aya hapuloma dla ka꞉dle yu Pepele dimo kokoye imsela꞉iyo. Epamsela꞉mama esusulumale so hapuloma mape ka꞉ka꞉demsela꞉iyo.

Epalati Ga꞉lili mo seme Siliya demdiye edla ha꞉ha꞉lalo so mape ya꞉ta koko halomsela꞉leye daliyo. Epapele koko tle opatapo esiyele mila꞉pi meyelope meyelope dle so opaye Yesuta ka꞉ka꞉dlepo depame ya꞉ hala dla hohopo pumhalaiyo. Epedeme yia꞉tapo esiyele mila꞉pi meyelope meyelope dle ipapeleye Yesu hala dla hohopo pumhalaiyo. Opitapo sikemte wotiyalle dulu dla ha꞉ha꞉lalo soye hohopo pumulaiyo, epela opitapo bataliya watalo soye hohopo pumulaiyo, epela opitapo yiyilalimale soye hohopo pumulaiyo, epela opitapo moto palli soye hohopo pumulaiyo. Epalati Yesutapo yia꞉ta hapulomaye ka꞉ka꞉diyo.
Epedeme opa hapuloma Ga꞉lili tle epame Dekapolis tle epo Yelusalem tle epame Yudiya tle epame mo opi Yoden aloma seme dla ha꞉ha꞉lalo tle Yesu hala dla puame ya꞉ dolumtamalaiyo.
